items.title: Unit 11 · Lesson 1 story
items.storyText:
The zoo. Great! I like animals. Look at the elephants, Billy. Oh no! I don't like elephants. They're big!

Look at the giraffes. Ahh! I don't like giraffes. They're tall!

Billy, you like animals. But you don't like elephants. And you don't like giraffes. Look over there!

I like monkeys! I like monkeys! They're little and I'm little too. Yes. They're funny and you're funny too!
